name: Project Context — sidebar entry opens the repo's context page
description: AC-4 of specs/2026-09-29-project-context.md. From the sidebar's WORKSPACE group, Project Context opens /repos/:repoId/context for the active repo and the page renders its heading. The seeded acme/payments-api has clonePath: null (server/src/db/seed.ts), so the page is in its 'not cloned' empty state and no .md document list or preview exists to assert; the list and preview are covered by the client component tests and server/test/project-context.it.test.ts. Deliberately asserts only the sidebar label, the route and the heading, not empty-state copy. Read-only, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (guaranteed by e2e-web.yml).
